messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
好的！如果您想訂製馬的雕塑，以下是可供選擇的材質：

| 材質 | 特色 |
|------|------|
| **青銅 (Bronze)** | 耐久、光澤感強，適合細節表現 |
| **大理石 (Marble)** | 高雅、光滑，適合傳統風格 |
| **陶土 (Terracotta)** | 低成本、可塑性好，適合較小尺寸 |
| **木材 (Wood)** | 自然紋理，溫暖感，易於加工 |
| **石材 (Stone)** | 堅固、重量感強，適合戶外展示 |

> **備註**：預設尺寸為 12 英吋（約 30 公分），您可以自行調整尺寸。

請問您想要哪一種材質？還是想先確認尺寸或其他細節？如果您已經決定，我可以幫您下單。
message.reasoning: The user says: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" They want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "有哪些材料選擇？" They want to know material options. According to the function, the sculpture_create_custom function has parameters: item (subject), material: "Bronze" | "Marble" | "Terracotta" | "Wood" | "Stone". So the user wants a bronze sculpture. They ask what materials are available. We can respond with the list of materials: Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. Also mention that they can choose size. Then we can offer to place an order. But the user didn't explicitly ask to place an order. They just asked "有哪些材料選擇？" So we should answer with the list. Then maybe ask if they'd like to proceed. We can also mention that the default size is 12 inches. So we can ask if they'd like to specify a size. So we respond accordingly.
